questions.q: Where do bold, underline, font, and color controls live for a selected text box?
options: The Home ribbon's Font group
Only inside the Expression dialog
The Insert tab
They can only be set through custom code
questions.explain: The Home tab's Font group applies bold, italic, underline, font, size, and color directly to whatever text box or cell is selected, without needing an expression.

questions.q: Where do you set a text box's border style and background fill color?
options: The Border and Fill tabs of that text box's Properties dialog
The Home ribbon's Font group
The Insert tab's Data Regions section
The Report Properties dialog, not the text box's own properties
questions.explain: Right-click a text box and select Text Box Properties — the Border tab controls edge style/width/color, and the Fill tab controls background color or image.

questions.q: How do you attach a hyperlink (Go to URL) to text in a text box?
options: Through the text box's Action tab in its Properties dialog
By typing http:// directly into the text and nothing else
Only through a report parameter
SSRS text boxes cannot contain hyperlinks
questions.explain: The Action tab on Text Box Properties lets you set an action such as Go to URL; you then style the text (underline, blue) separately so it visually reads as a link.

questions.q: What does the WritingMode property control?
options: Rotating text 90 or 270 degrees inside its box
Whether the text box shows expressions or literal values
The text box's border thickness
Whether the text box appears on odd or even pages
questions.explain: WritingMode, found in the Properties pane, changes from Default to Rotate270 (or Rotate90) to make text run vertically instead of horizontally.

questions.q: In the lesson's screenshot, what three separate text box techniques appear in one report?
options: Currency formatting, a styled hyperlink, and rotated column-header text
Three different fonts and nothing else
Three different border colors only
A chart, a map, and a gauge
questions.explain: The screenshot shows currency-formatted Sales values, a blue underlined hyperlinked Link Text column, and a Territory header rotated via WritingMode.
